title: A macOS notification banner disappears before it is pressed
symptom: desktop wait or find sees the banner, but the next click returns ref_stale or the banner is gone
cause: Banners leave the screen after about 5 seconds; a find between wait and click costs one more process start
fix: launch_cli.py desktop wait --window overlay --text "<banner text>"  # returns matches with ref, no find needed
launch_cli.py desktop click --ref <ref> --action "<name from named_actions>"  # hidden buttons (Close, Allow) need no hover
If it was missed, do the step that sends the notification again
